daSamo~adhyAyaH |
atha gaNDUShakavalapratisAraNavidhiH |
UrShvagatadoShaharatvasAmAnyAt dhUmapAnamaBidhAya saMpratigaNDUShaM kavalaM pratisAraNavidhimAraByate ||
caturvidhaH#foot@ - suSrute - snehI, prasAdI, saMSodhanaropaNAvityanyathA caturvidhatvamuktam | tathA tantrAntare vairecanasaMSamanAByAM ShadvidhatvamuktaM tathApyatra saMSodhane vairecanasya prasAdane SamanasyAntarBAvAnna virodhaH |# syAdgaNDUShaH snaihikaH SamanastathA | 
Sodhano ropaNaScaiva kavalaScApi tadvidhaH || 1 || 
snigdhaistu snaihiko vAte svAduSItaiH prasAdanaH | 
pitte kaTvamlalavaNairuShNaiH saMSodhanaH kaPe || 2 || 
kaShAyatiktamadhuraiH kaduShNo ropaNo vraNe | 
catuShprakAro gaNDUShaH kavalaScApi kIrtitaH || 3 || 
asaMcArI muKe pUrNe gaNDUShaH kavalaScaraH | 
tatra draveNa gaNDUShaH kalkena kavalaH smRutaH || 4 || 
dadyAddraveShu cUrNaM ca gaNDUShe kolamAtrakam | 
karShapramANaH kalkaSca dIyate kavale budhaiH || 5 ||

vya_text: gU0 – caturvidhatvamAha - ekaH snehanaH dvitIyaH SamanaH tRutIyaH SodhanaH caturtho ropaNaH evaM caturvidhaH kavalaH | yairdravyairdoShepu snaihikAdayo Bavanti tatprakAramAha - vAte snigdhoShNairdravyaiH snaihikaH svAdurmadhurastathA SItaH pitte taiH prasAdanaH praSamano Bavati | kaTvamlalavaNairdravyaiH uShNaiH kaPe saMSodhanaH | vraNe kIdRuSo deyastadapyAha - kaShAyatiktamadhurairdravyaiH kaTUShNaH vraNaropaNa evaM caturvidhaScatuHprakAro gaNDUShaH kathitaH, kavalaScApi tatprakArastadvidha eva, ato gaNDUShakavalayorlakShaNamAha - tatra draveNa pUrNe muKe asaMcArI asaMcaraNaSIlo gaNDUShaH kalkataScaraScalanaSIlaH kavalaH muKa eva | gaNDUShakalkayorauShadhapramANamAha - gaNDUShadravyAt draveShu cUrNaM kolamAtrakaM deyaM kalAShTakadvayAnAM kavale dravyAtkalkaH karShapramANaH | karShaShTaMkacatuShTayAnAm ||1-5||

dI0 - kavalaScApi tadvidha ityanena kavalo~api snehakAdicaturBedaireva boddhavyaH | yathA catuHprakAro gaNDUShastathaiva kavalaScatuHprakAro BavatItyaBiprAyaH | atha yaccatuHprakAraM tatprakAravidhAnamAha - snigdhaistu snaihikamityasya sthAne suSrute snigdhoShNaiH snaihike vAta iti pAThaH sAdhuH | snaihike gaNDUShakavalayorBedaH kArya iti SeShaH | svAduSItaH prasAdanaH pitte praSastaH | svAdurmadhuraH SItasparSAdvIryAdvAnnasAdano gaNDUShaparyAyaH | sa cAtra SamanaBedo j~jeyaH | kadvamlalavaNairiti saMSodhanamiti gaNDUShakavalataraparyAyavAcakABidhAnaM kaPe praSastam | kaiH kaTvAmlAdiBiriti | uShNairityasya sthAne rUkShairiti pAThAntaram | kaShAyatiktamadhurairiti vraNe muKajanitapiDakAdirUpe | ropaNo gaNDUShasaMj~ja: | kaTvamla ityasya sthAne kaTUShNa iti pAThaH pracarati | eBiScatuHprakAraiH kRutvA gaNDUShaH kathitaH | na kevalaM gaNDUShaH kavalaScApIdRuSo~avagantavyaH | asyAnte keciditi paThanti | ‘evaM snehaH payaHkShaudrarasamUtrAmlasaMsmRutaH | kaShAyoShNodakAByAM ca kavalA doShato hitA’ iti | bahupustakeShu na liKitaM | sarvoktenaiva kRutArthatvAt | atha gaNDUShakavalayorBinnatvapratipAdanArthaM vidhAnamAha - pUrNe muKe saMBRutamuKakuhare yo saMcArI Bavati calanAdirahitaH sa gaNDUShaH kathitaH | tadviparItaH kavala iti | ata eva dravadravyeNa gaNDUShaH kalkena kavala ityarthaH | tathAcoktaM cakradatte - ‘muKaM saMcAryate jAnumAtrA ca kavalena tu | asaMcAryA tu yA mAtrA gaNDUShe sA prakIrtitA’ iti | ayameva pAThaH suSrute | gaNDUShakavalayordravyANAM parimANamAha -gaNDUShe gaNDUShakaraNavidhau cUrNe vA | gaNDUShe komalamAtrakaM karShapramANakalkam akavale dIyate budhaiH | gaNDUShe gaNDUShakaraNavidhau cUrNaM vyAdhivihitadravyakRutaM rajaH komalamAtramiti karShArdham | draveShu toyakShIrAdipraBRutiShu saMsrAvya dadyAdityarthaH | dravaparimANamuktaM yAvanmuKapUrNaM Bavati tatparimANaM caikavAraM gaNDUShAnimittam | punaH punararthaM ca bahutaradravaM saMgRuhya tadanusAreNa cUrNamapi saMsrAvya deyam | evaM sarvaM praj~jAtavyam | tathAcoktaM suSrute - ‘tAvacca dhArayitavyo~ananyamanasA saMcArayitavyaSca | yAvaddoShapratipUrNagalakapolatvagnAsAsrotonayanapariplavaSca Bavati| tadA vimoktavya: | punaScAnyo gRuhItavyam’ iti | SeShaM sugamam || 1-5 ||

pada:
kasmin vayasi gaNDUSho dhAryate kiyatparimitA gaNDUShAH kAryA ityAha -
dhAryante pa~jcamAdvarShAdgaNDUShakavalAdayaH | 
gaNDUShAnsusthitaH kuryAtsvinnaBAlagalAdikaH ||6|| 
manuShyastrIMstathA pa~jca sapta vA doShanASanAt | 
kaPapUrNAsyatA yAvacCedo doShasya vA Bavet || 7 || 
netraGrANasrutiryAvattAvadgaNDUShadhAraNam |

vya_text: gU0 - gaDUShakavalAdayaH pa~jcamAdvarShAdvayasaH | gaNDUShadhAraNapramANamAha - susthitaH manuShyaH trIn tathA pa~jca sapta vA doShanASanAt gaNDUShAnkuryAt | susthitaH suKena sthitaH, kiMBUtaH ? svinnaBAlagalAdikaH svinnaH prasvedayukto BAlo galAdikaM ca yasya saH | anyadapi gaNDUShadhAraNe pramANamAha - netraGrANasrutistrAvo vA yAvat tAvadeva gaNDUShadhAraNam idaM vA pramANam || 6 || 7 ||

dI0 - atha kIdRuSo gaNDUShakavalayogyastamAha - pa~jcamAdvarShAdupari bAlyAvasthAyAmeva gaNDUShakavalAdayo dhAryante | AdigrahaNAtpratisAraNasyA~atra saMgrahaH | pa~jcamavarShagrahaNaM tantrAntare~api darSitaM | tadyathA - ‘dhUmo dvAdaSavarShasya kavalaH pa~jcame hitaH’ iti | atha kiyatsaMKyABirgaNDUShaviShayaH taM darSayannAha - gaNDUSham antaHsthitaM muKamadhyasthitaM yasya sa tathA; punaH svinnA BAlagalAdayo yasya sa tathA | BAlaH kapAlaH, AdigrahaNAnnAsAsrotonayanAdInAM grahaNam | IdRuSo rogI trivelaM pa~jcavAraM vA gaNDUShaM kuryAdityaBiprAyaH | athavA doShanASanAnmaryAdIkRutyetyarthaH | kecinnibandhakArA ‘gaNDUShAnsusthita’ ityamuM SlokaM vakShyamANaM ‘kaPapUrNAsyatA’ iti yAvat SlokaM ca na paThanti | kShepakAviti manyamAnatvAt | vakShyamANo yathA ‘kaPapUrNAsyatA yAvacCedo doShasya vA Bavet | netraGrANasrutiryAvattAvadgaNDUShadhAraNam’ | asmAkaM mate tu yuktArthatvena saMgatAveva | bahupustakeShu liKitadarSanAt || 6 || 7 ||

pada:
vAte snaihikagaNDUShamAha -
tilakalkodakaM kShIraM sneho vA snaihike hitaH ||8|| 
tilA nIlotpalaM sarpiH SarkarA kShIrameva ca |
sakShaudro hanuvaktrastho gaNDUSho dAhanASanaH || 9 || 
vaiSadyaM janayatyAsye saMdadhAti muKavraNAn |
dAhatRuShNApraSamanaM madhugaNDUShadhAraNam || 10 || 
viShakShArAgnidagdhe ca sarpirdhAryaM payo~athavA |
tailasaindhavagaNDUSho dantacAle praSasyate || 11 || 
SoShaM muKasya vairasyaM gaNDUShaH kA~jjiko jayet |
sindhutrikaTurAjIBirArdrakeNa kaPe hitaH || 12 || 
triPalAmadhugaNDUShaH kaPAsRukpittanASanaH |

vya_text: gU0 - snaihike gaNDUShe tilakalkaH udakaM jalaM kShIraM dugdhaM sneho vA tailAdikaH hitaH | vAtaroge eva vAtasya prayogAt | atha pitte gaNDUShaH Samana evocyate nIlAdInAM hanuvakrastho gaNDUSho dAhanASano Bavati | dAho muKadAhaH hanvASritaM vaktraM tatrasthaH | atha muKavraNAdau madhugaNDUShaH vaiSadyaM viSadatvaM | nirmalateti yAvat Asye muKe muKavraNAn sPoTAnsaMdadhAti saMdhAnaM karoti | spaShTamanyat | viShAdau gaNDUShAnAha - sarpirGRutaM, payo dugdham | atha dantacAle gaNDUShaH tileti spaShTaM | atha muKaSoShe Sotheti sugamam | atha kaPe saMSodhanaH rAjI prasiddhA | atha kaPAsRukpitte triPaleti | sugamam || 8-12 ||

dI0 - idAnIM caturvidhayoH kavalagaNDUShayoH katipayAn yogAnAha - snaihike gaNDUShe tilakalkavastraniShpIDitamudakamiti | kShIramatra sAmAnyena gopraBRutijanitaM | snehaScApyevam | atha kShArAdidagdhavakrasya yogamAha | tiletyAdiyogo vyastaH samastaSca yojyaH | yadAha kaScit - ‘gaNDUShaH SarkarAkShaudrapiShTamAMsapayastilaiH | vyastaiH samastairyojyastu muKe kShArAditApita’ iti | ‘saMdadhAti muKe vraNAn’ ityasya sthAne ‘saMnihanti muKavraNAni’ti pAThaH sAdhuH | dAhatRuShNAdayo muKasyeti viShakShArAgnidagdhe muKe iti SeShaH | dhAryamityanena gaNDUShaviShayam | aparANyAha - tailaM kA~jjikayogaM saindhavaM vihAya kShIradagdhe~api pracarati | tathAhyuktaM ‘tAmbUlamadhyasthitacUrNakena dagdhaM muKaM yasya Bavet kathaMcit | tailena gaNDUShamasau vidadhyAdamlAranAlena punaH punarvA’ iti | atha doShaviSeSheNa dravyaviSeShajanitAn pradarSayannAha | siMdhutrikaTurAjIBirityanena kavalayogamAhuH | saindhavAdayo vyastAH samastASca yojyAH | yadyetevAM gaNDUShastadA kalkaM kRutvA paTe visrAvya taddraveNa gaNDUShaH kArya ityarthaH | triPaletyAdiyogaH kvathito boddhavyaH | kalka iti kecit | kaPAsRukpittaprakopamuKasthitamiti BAvaH || 8-12 ||

pada:
atha muKapAke gaNDUShaH -
(pratisAraNacUrNam)
dArvI guDUcI triPalA drAkShA jAtyASca pallavAH ||13|| 
yavAsaSceti takkAthaH ShaShThAMSakShaudrasaMyutaH |
SIto muKe dhRuto hanyAnmuKapAkaM tridoShajam ||14|| 
yasyauShadhasya gaNDUShastasya vai pratisAraNam |
kavalaScApi tasyaiva j~jeyo~atra kuSalairnaraiH || 15 || 
keSaraM mAtulu~ggasya saindhavoShaNasaMyutam |
hanyAtkavalato jADyamaruciM kaPavAtajAm ||16|| 
kalko~avalehacUrNaM ca trividhaM pratisAraNam |
a~ggulyagragRuhItaM ca yathAsvaM muKarogiNam ||17|| 
kuShThaM dArvI sama~ggA ca pAThA tiktA ca pItikA | 
tejanI muKalodhre ca cUrNaM syAtpratisAraNam ||18|| 
raktasnutiM dantapIDAM SothaM dAhaM ca nASayet |

vya_text: gU0 - dArvI dAruharidrA jAtI mAlatIpatrANi vAsakaH kvAthAt ShaShThAMSaH kShaudraM madhu yasya gaNDUShasyaiva pratisAraNaM kavalaScetyAha yasyeti sugamaM | kavalo yathA mAtulu~ggasya bIjapUrasya keSaraM madhyasthaM saindhavaM maricam etatkavalo jADyaM muKajaDatAm aruciM kaPavAtajAM kaPavAtajAtAM | pratisAraNaM trividhaM BavatItyAha - kalkaH avalehaH tathA cUrNaM trividhaM triprakAraM pratisAraNaM Bavati muKarogiNAM yathAsuKaM yathAdoShaM trividhaM pratisAraNasaMj~jaM Bavati | kiMBUtam aMgulyagragRuhItaM kalkAdyaM pratisAraNaM yathA kuShThaM, dArvI, dAruharidrA, sama~ggA ma~jjiShThA, pAThA tiktA kaTukI, pItikA haridrA, tejanI tejohvA, mustaM BadramustaM, lodhram etatpratisAraNaM cUrNam a~ggulyagreNa GarShayet | raktasrAvAdIn nASayet || 13-18 ||

dI0 - aparamapi muKapAkayogamAha | dArvI dAruharidrA triPalA harItakIviBItakAmalakasaMj~jA | jAtI mAlatI | yavAsa ityasya sthAne aMbaShThA ceti tatkvAthaH pAThaH sAdhuH | anyato darSanAt | tathAhi - ‘jAtIpatrAmRutAdrAkShApAThAdArvIPalatrikaiH | kvAthaH kShaudrayutaH SIto gaNDUSho muKapAkanut’ iti | ShaShThAMSakShaudrasaMyuta iti | kvathitajalasya yatShaShThAMSaM tena samaM kShaudramiti | athavA ShaShThAMSakShaudrasaMyuta iti pAThaH samIcIno j~jeyaH | tena kkAthasya pa~jcaBAgAH ShaShTho BAgaH kShaudrasyeti vyAKyAnaM samIcInam | muKe dhRuta ityanena gaNDUShaviShaya: | ‘yasyauShadhasya gaNDUShaH tasyaiva pratisAraNam | kavalaScApi tasyaiva j~jeyo~atra kuSalairnaraiH’ ayaM Sloko bahupustakeShu na liKitaH | kenacitsaMliKya svIkRutaH | saMgatoyamitimanyamAnairasmABirapi na tyAjyaH yuktArthatvAt | atha kavalArthaM yogamAha - mAtulu~ggo bIjapUrakaH | tasya keSaraM madhyasthitAvayavaviSeShaM loke catUrInnAmakaM vAcyaM | saindhavoShaNacUrNe manAk deyam | uShaNaM maricaM | jADyamiti muKasyeti | pUrvamuktaM pratisAraNaviShayaM tadidAnIM darSayannAha | pratisAryate GRuShyate aneneti pratisAraNam | nanu tantrAntare pratisAraNaviShayaM caturvidhaM tadyathA - ‘viBajya BeShajaM buddhyA kurvIta pratisAraNaM | kalko rasakriyA kShaudraM cUrNaM ceti caturvidham | aMgulyagrapraNItaM tu yathAsvaM muKarogiNAm | tasya yogamayogaM ca kavalAktaM viBAvayet’ | tatkathamatra trividham | ucyate | atrAvalehatvena rasakriyA: kShaudrayostadantaH pracAraH | tenAvalehagrahaNena dvayorapi grahaNamityadoShaH | atha pratisAraNacUrNaM darSayannAha - kuShThaM ruk, dArvI dAruharidrAsamaM gA~jjalikArikA, pAThA ambaShThA, tiktA kaTukI, pItikA haridrA tejanI cavikA iti cakraH | mUrvA iti kArtikaH | mustaM meGaH, lodhraM prasiddham | raktasrutiratra dantamUlagatadoShasyaiva boddhavyA | SothadAhamapi muKajanitameva || 13-18 ||

pada:
hInayogamAha -
hInayogAtkaPotkleSo rasAj~jAnArucI tathA ||19|| 
atiyogAnmuKe pAkaH SoShastRuShNA klamo Bavet |

vya_text: gU0 - gaNDUShAdInAM hInayogAt hInamAtrAkaraNAt kaPokleSaH kaPAdhikyaM rasAj~jAnArucI rasAnAM madhurAdInAm aj~jAnaM yathArthasvAdalABaH tathA arucirasAruci atrArucirvA ete BavataH | atiyogAt gaNDUShAdInAmatikaraNAt muKe pAkaH SoShastRuShNAklamo glAniH etadBavet || 19 ||

dI0 - idAnIM hInAtiyogatvena gaNDUShAdInAM doShamAha - hInayogAt kaPotkleSa iti | kaPAdhikacetotkleSa upasthitavamanonmuKatA rasAj~jAnAruciH | tatheti rasAnAM madhurAdInAm aj~jAnaM rasanendriyaviShayahAnirityaBiprAyaH | arucistrividhaH | aruciranannABinandanam | BaktadveSha iti | tadyathA satyAM buBukShAyAmaByavahArAsAmarthyamityaruciH | anaBilaShitamapyannaM dIyamAnamaByavaharatItyannABinandanam | annasya SravaNasmaraNadarSanasparSanairyatrodvejite sa BaktadveSha iti | atiyogAditi | gaNDUShakavalAdInAmeva | eke hInAtiyogaviShayaM SodhanAKyagaNDUShaM mAnayanti | tathAcoktaM ‘SodhanIye viSeSheNa Bavatyetattu lakShaNam’ iti || 19 ||

pada:
SuddhagaNDUShalakShaNamAha -
vyAdherapacayastuShTirvaiSadyaM vaktralAGavam || 20 ||
indriyANAM prasAdaSca gaNDUShe SuddhilakShaNam |
iti SrIdAmodarasUnunA SAr~ggadhareNa viracitAyAM
SAr~ggadharasaMhitAyAmuttaraKaNDe gaNDUShAdi-
vidhirnAma daSamo~adhyAyaH || 10 ||

vya_text:
gU0 - gaNDUShe satataM SuddhalakShaNaM samyak kRutaM gaNDUShalakShaNaM yadvA muKaSuddhilakShaNaM kiM tallakShaNamityAha - vyAdherapacayo nASaH vyAdheH muKe kaPaliptatAjyAdeH tuShTisaMtoShaH vaiSadyaM viSadatA vaktralAGavaM gurutAnASaH indriyANAM rasAdInAM prasAdaH prasannatA etallakShaNaM Bavati || 20 ||
iti SrIkASIrAmamiSrakRutAyAM SAr~ggadharagUDhArthadIpikAyAM
cikitsAsthAne gaNDUShAdividhi-
radhyAya: || 10 ||

dI0 - atha samyak SIlitasya gaNDUShasya SuddhilakShaNaM | vyAdherapacayo vinASa: | tuShTiH saMtoShaH | vaiSadyaM muKasyeti | indriyANAM SravaNanayanaGrANarasanAdInAM prasAdaH svaviShayagrahaNasAmarthyam | eke apacayasthAne apanayaH, gaNDUShasthAne kavala iti paThanti | tatrApi sa evArthaH || 20 ||
iti SrIBAvasiMhAtmajenADhamallena viracitAyAM
SAr~ggadharadIpikAyAmuttaraKaNDe
kavalAdhyAyaH || 10 ||
